**Project risk:** ⭐ Amber – the app handles payment data (credit‑card details) and stores it on Stripe. We’ll add a “save card” option that lets customers pull their card from Stripe when they come back. This is a **secure** way to avoid re‑typing, but it requires careful handling of secrets, Stripe‑only keys, and row‑level security on Supabase so that no one else can see anyone else’s card tokens. --- ## 1. One‑screen plan (approved before coding) | What we’re building | One‑sentence goal | |---------------------|-------------------| | **Customer‑saved‑card flow** | Let customers choose “Keep my card on file” during checkout, then automatically use that card the next time they buy. | | Who uses it | Risk level | Day‑one features | |-------------|------------|------------------| | Any visitor who uses the checkout | Amber | 1️⃣ Show “Keep my card on file” checkbox 2️⃣ Store Stripe customer ID, card ID 3️⃣ Auto‑select card on subsequent checkout | | Information stored | Private? | |--------------------|----------| | Stripe customer ID, Stripe payment method ID | Yes | | Logins | Money | |--------|-------| | **No** (we’ll rely on Stripe’s customer object for identity) | Yes – payments via Stripe, server‑only API keys | | Built with | Why | |------------|-----| | **React** (frontend) + **Vite** + **Supabase** (database + auth) + **Stripe** (payments) | Fast, modern stack with built‑in security practices | | Steps | |-------| 1. Add a checkbox in the checkout UI.
2. When the user taps “Pay”, create a Stripe customer if none exists, attach the payment method, and store the customer’s ID and payment‑method ID in Supabase (private table).
3. On future visits, look up the stored customer ID, fetch the last payment method ID from Stripe, and pre‑select it.
4. Add RLS policies so only the owner can read their card token row. | | Safety | Why | |--------|-----| | **Keys secret** – we’ll put Stripe secret key in `.env` (ignored by git).
**Data locked** – Supabase RLS, only the user sees their row.
**Spending caps** – use Stripe’s billing alerts.
**Save point** – we’ll make a commit before each change. | > **Does this look right?** > Reply **yes** to proceed, or say what to adjust.
